_notes: Mud Burst: the thrown glob. One painted still (mud_glob.png, 1254x1254), a heavy wet glob of earth-brown mud thrown to the right with a stringy tail and three drips trailing left, on a #00FF00 green screen. Keyed on hue with keyed: "green-soft" (a plain green key clamps green to min(r,b), which pulls browns toward red), then cropped to its own ink. Matte on purpose: no tint, no glow.
